source_data.desc:
You have Resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

| 1d10 | Damage Type |
|---|---|
|1|Acid|
|2|Cold|
|3|Fire|
|4|Force|
|5|Lightning|
|6|Necrotic|
|7| Poison|
|8|Psychic|
|9|Radiant|
|10|Thunder|
source_data.name: Armor of Resistance (Chain Mail)
